# Vendored PluginBridge SDK

`rokid-prism-pluginbridge-plugin-sdk-0.1.3.tgz` was generated from the sibling
`prism-plugin-sdk/node` source with `npm test` followed by `npm pack`. Its SHA-256
is `8b8ead0f47d73bc75359ac1dc807bfbbd2c4bb06254f82b1a34a61499a78e0ba`.
The package is fixed in `package-lock.json` so the plugin can run `npm ci` in
an isolated release checkout before SDK 0.1.3 is published to npm. Refresh it
after any SDK source change that affects this plugin.
